item.title: Fences
item.description:
Occasionally when I’m walking through my city, I see a set of fences blocking off a small section of a side walk. Those fences are most likely there because for a while there was like a small crane or something there and they wanted it to not be touched by random people.

But because this would be a boring and way too obvious conclusion I like to imagine they are containing invisible anomolies. Those things you read about in SCP articles or like the things from STALKER.

item.title: Tv Noise
item.description:
So yea, I was just sitting in front of my desk to do some drawing or whatever else when my first thought was “better put up some music as background” and that sort of made me reminisce. It made me nostalgic for a time more than a decade ago (yeez now I truly feel old) when during the weekends I occasionally and stayed at my grandparents.

At my grandparents I had my own room with a bed, desk, and even a TV! A very blocky tv so imagine just any old school crt tv in gray. I had this thing standing on my, might I say, quite large desk on the right hand side. Whenever I was gaming on my shitty office laptop that I truly put through the wringer while I was trying to play whatever videogame tickled my fancy in that moment. So like CS:GOor League of Legends.
